raw:
@q query
  select ?place
  where match
    relation "live in"
    role subject "Lars"
    role location ?place
    polarity affirmed
  end

@q2 query
  select ?t
  measure end
  where match
    relation "take care of"
    role subject "Mircea"
    role object "the reporting dashboard"
    role time ?t
    polarity affirmed
  end

@q3 query
  select ?coach
  where match
    relation "be the coach of"
    role subject ?coach
    role object "Busan United"
    polarity affirmed
  end

@a1 assumed
  relation "publish"
  role subject "Blue Harbor Media"
  role object "Drumul Sării"
  polarity affirmed
  basis disambiguation

@q4 query
  where match
    relation "publish"
    role subject "Blue Harbor Media"
    role object "Drumul Sării"
    polarity affirmed
  end
